_status: PROPOSED. Not part of AgentWeb's linkedin.com map as of 24 Nov 2026. Nothing here has been confirmed by AgentWeb or observed live.
_basis: Mirrors list_profile_posts / list_profile_posts_next as listed publicly on 24 Nov 2026 (field names hedged as reported from the public map listing). Summary style follows ActionMap.curated: {domain, version, actions[{name, description, params}]}. The exact shape AgentWeb uses for `params` in a curated summary is not public; the object form below is our proposal.
_open_questions: Which sort and date_posted values LinkedIn's Posts search offers, and their wire names.
Whether keywords honour quoted phrases and Boolean operators in the Posts tab.
Whether the activity URN or a share URL is the stable permalink, and the canonical permalink format.
Whether one page of search is billed as one completed action.
Whether next_token is top-level or per-row in AgentWeb's list_profile_posts output (we accept both).

actions.name: search_posts
actions.description: Read-only. Keyword search of LinkedIn Posts results from the connected member's session. The keyword string is passed through unchanged. Returns one page of posts and an opaque next_token (null at the end).

keywords.description: Passed through unchanged (quotes, Boolean operators and unicode preserved). Must contain a non-whitespace character.

sort.description: Proposed values; to be matched to what the Posts tab offers.

date_posted.description: Proposed values; to be matched to what the Posts tab offers.

count.description: Mirrors list_profile_posts (default 10, max 100). String digits are accepted since execute coerces scalars to strings.

value.query: Echo of {keywords, sort, date_posted} as received, so a caller can verify pass-through.
value.next_token: Opaque string, or null at the end. Bound to the query that produced it.

actions.name: search_posts_next
actions.description: Read-only. Next page of search_posts. keywords, sort and date_posted must equal the values that produced pagination_token; a mismatch is INVALID_PARAMS. Pass pagination_token unchanged.

keywords.description: Same value as the first call.

sort.description: Same value as the first call.

date_posted.description: Same value as the first call.

row._mirrors: list_profile_posts row fields as listed publicly on 24 Nov 2026, plus permalink and posted_at_approx. Only activity_urn and permalink are strictly required (permalink_source is a requested optional field); text, age and engagement counts may be null (media-only posts, hidden counts).

age.description: Relative age as LinkedIn shows it, e.g. 3h, 2d, 1w.

permalink.description: Share URL with tracking params removed; if none exists, a URL built from activity_urn (format to confirm).

permalink_source.description: Where permalink came from. constructed_from_urn means the /feed/update/<urn>/ form, whose stability is unconfirmed.

posted_at_approx.description: ISO-8601 estimate derived from age. Always approximate.

reshared_activity_urn.description: Requested so a repost can be linked to its original. Not in list_profile_posts as listed; consumers must handle its absence.
